attractions.name: Santa Cruz Cathedral Basilica
attractions.description: Historic church with an imposing façade, colourful interior paintings and stained-glass windows; present structure consecrated in 1905 and elevated to basilica in 1984.
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Nidhi- Kerala- All Inclusive Guide_14102026.docx

attractions.name: St Francis Church
attractions.description: One of India's oldest European-built churches, established by the Portuguese in the early 16th century and the original burial place of Vasco da Gama.
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Nidhi- Kerala- All Inclusive Guide_14102026.docx

attractions.name: Chinese Fishing Nets
attractions.description: Enormous cantilevered fishing nets on the Fort Kochi waterfront, one of Kerala's most recognisable sights.
tips: Late-afternoon light is excellent for photographs and sunset views
The nets are a landmark rather than a guaranteed demonstration, so active fishing times vary
